script_text: Mars, your ruling planet as a Fire sign, is igniting your 10th House of career this week, and the universe has a major confrontation waiting for you. Early week, the Sun square Mars creates tension—avoid clashes with authority figures Monday and Tuesday. By Wednesday, Venus trine Neptune opens a beautiful love connection, possibly through a creative friend or artistic circle. Mercury enters your 7th House midweek, shifting your focus toward deep partnerships and meaningful collaboration. Late week, Mars opposes Saturn Friday—this is NOT the time to push against limits; strategize your next move instead. Your career breakthrough arrives Thursday when Jupiter conjuncts your 2nd House—unexpected money or a promotion surfaces. Best day is Thursday for career moves; worst is Friday for love—patience wins here. Fire energy fuels your passion, but channel Mars wisely this week. Follow for daily updates and insights.
